cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says a social registry is in service; the National Social Registry was at a pilot of 821 people in Addis Ababa in 2025. OpenG2P's Fayda seeding is held, but a link does not lift a registry still under way.
cells.note: Stage 4c: the Ministry of Women and Social Affairs is setting up a National Social Registry, piloted with 821 people (ETH-002), so under way. The relief registration of about 300,000 people is one agency's list, removed (corrections.csv), so not 3.
